descripcion: Time for a new monthly 9x9 tournament by Go Magic! Please help us improve these tournaments by answering this very short poll: Answer Poll All prizes are Go Magic Gift Cards 🏆Prizes: 1st Place: $100 2nd Place: $80 3rd Place: $60 🏆 Special Prizes (mutually exclusive with winning): 6 Wins: $50 5 Wins: $30 All you have to do is register and be here at the starting time! The next rounds will start as soon as all the games are finished. The expected total duration is about 1.5h ⌚ **The start time is shown in your local timezone!!** **Absolute start time is:** **Saturday, July 18, 2026 7:00 PM UTC** Add to your calendar: [**Google**](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE&dates=20260718T190000Z%2F20260718T210000Z&details=&location=&text=Go%20Magic%20July%209x9%20) | [**Outlook**](https://outlook.live.com/calendar/0/action/compose?allday=false&body=&enddt=2026-07-18T23%3A00%3A00&location=&path=%2Fcalendar%2Faction%2Fcompose&rru=addevent&startdt=2026-07-18T21%3A00%3A00&subject=Go%20Magic%20July%209x9%20) 🪄✨ Learn Go the Magical way at Go Magic
